dct_description_sm: Beaver Creek is an experimental road site where mitigation techniques, aiming to control permafrost degradation along the Alaska Highway, are being tested since implementation in summer 2008. The site comprises 12 sub-sections including a control sub-section.  Geophysical surveys were intended to estimate the cryostratigraphy profiling in-between boreholes, thus optimizing our understanding of the cryostratigraphy at the Beaver Creek site. Surveys were also conducted in order to identify taliks under the road.

dct_title_s: Beaver Creek experimental site geophysical data
